verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents one first-party event-triggered automation: online scoring runs scorers on production traces automatically as they are logged. There is no evidence of a general rule engine that lets users define conditions and pick actions such as alerts or notifications. CI/CD evals run on the host CI platform, and Patterns runs on a schedule rather than on events, so neither earns credit. missing for 10: user-definable rule/condition configuration, a choice of triggered action types (alerts, webhooks, dataset additions), documentation of automation rules, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Online scoring evaluates production traces automatically as they’re logged, running asynchronously with no impact on latency.
Use a dataset for experiments or production traces for online scoring.
